_readme: Single source of truth for the OAuth scope vocabulary: the wire token, the Preferences-dialog description (frontend audience: a developer registering an app), the consent-screen sentence (hub audience: a person granting access -- the two texts are deliberately different), the family grouping both surfaces render, and the implied-by graph the register form locks and the hub expands. task generate-contracts cross-checks the whole file against the Scope proto enum (scopes + nonGrantable must partition it exactly; categories must cover each grantable scope exactly once; impliedBy must reference grantable scopes and stay acyclic) and emits Go tables (authscope and the OAuth consent pages consume them) and the TS records (scopeCatalogue and scopeToken consume them).

SCOPE_ACCOUNT_READ.description: Read the signed-in account's profile: username, email, verification state, administrator flag.
SCOPE_ACCOUNT_READ.consentSentence: Read your profile: your username, your email address and whether you are an administrator.

SCOPE_ACCOUNT_WRITE.description: Change the account's profile and preferences. No app reaches the credential surface.
SCOPE_ACCOUNT_WRITE.consentSentence: Change your profile and your account settings, including your password.

SCOPE_WORKSPACE_READ.description: Read workspaces, tabs and the layout document.
SCOPE_WORKSPACE_READ.consentSentence: Read your workspaces, your tabs and your layout.

SCOPE_WORKSPACE_WRITE.description: Create, rename, move and close workspaces and tabs, and submit layout operations.
SCOPE_WORKSPACE_WRITE.consentSentence: Create, rename, move and close your workspaces and tabs.

SCOPE_WORKER_READ.description: List the account's workers and open a channel to one. Every other worker-surface scope implies it.
SCOPE_WORKER_READ.consentSentence: List your workers and connect to one.

SCOPE_WORKER_ADMIN.description: Administer the account's own workers: rename, deregister, and manage the registration keys that let a machine join.
SCOPE_WORKER_ADMIN.consentSentence: Rename and deregister your workers, and manage the keys that let a machine join.

SCOPE_AGENT_READ.description: Read coding-agent sessions: messages, plans, settings, todos.
SCOPE_AGENT_READ.consentSentence: Read your coding-agent sessions, including every message in them.

SCOPE_AGENT_WRITE.description: Drive a coding agent: send a prompt, answer a permission request, start, stop, or change its settings.
SCOPE_AGENT_WRITE.consentSentence: Send prompts to your coding agents and answer their permission requests.

SCOPE_TERMINAL_READ.description: Read terminal output and metadata. This is a monitoring dashboard.
SCOPE_TERMINAL_READ.consentSentence: Read the output of your terminals.

SCOPE_TERMINAL_WRITE.description: Type into a terminal. This is arbitrary code execution on the account's machine.
SCOPE_TERMINAL_WRITE.consentSentence: Type into your terminals, which runs any command on your machine.

SCOPE_FILE_READ.description: Browse directories and read files on a worker.
SCOPE_FILE_READ.consentSentence: Browse and read files on your machines.

SCOPE_GIT_READ.description: Read git state: status, branches, diffs, log.
SCOPE_GIT_READ.consentSentence: Read the git state of your repositories: status, branches, diffs and history.

SCOPE_GIT_WRITE.description: Mutate a repository: commit, push, create or delete a branch, manage a worktree.
SCOPE_GIT_WRITE.consentSentence: Commit, push, and create or delete branches in your repositories.

SCOPE_TUNNEL_OPEN.description: Open a TCP tunnel through a worker.
SCOPE_TUNNEL_OPEN.consentSentence: Open network connections from inside your private network to any address it can reach.

SCOPE_ADMIN_READ.description: Read the hub's administrative inventory: users, settings, workers, sessions, credentials.
SCOPE_ADMIN_READ.consentSentence: Read this hub's administration: every account, setting, worker and credential.

SCOPE_ADMIN_USERS.description: Administer accounts: create, update, delete, reset a password, revoke sessions and credentials.
SCOPE_ADMIN_USERS.consentSentence: Administer every account on this hub, including resetting passwords.

SCOPE_ADMIN_SETTINGS.description: Change the hub's settings, including its security policy and its identity providers.
SCOPE_ADMIN_SETTINGS.consentSentence: Change this hub's settings, including its security policy and its sign-in providers.

SCOPE_ADMIN_WORKERS.description: Administer every worker on the hub, and the registration keys that admit one.
SCOPE_ADMIN_WORKERS.consentSentence: Administer every worker on this hub.

SCOPE_ADMIN_APPS.description: Register, edit, vouch, retire and delete the hub's app registrations.
SCOPE_ADMIN_APPS.consentSentence: Register, edit, vouch, retire and delete the hub's app registrations.
